Trigger on: Neon, PostgreSQL, Postgres, database, schema, sales_state, sales_factfinder, sales_insurance, sales_systems, sales_quotes, column_registry, migration, connection pooling, NEON_DATABASE_URL, pipeline tracking, prospect data, meeting data, CF D1, CF KV, Cloudflare Workers, or any reference to the sales data layer. Also trigger when discussing CRM intake, 4-meeting process state, quote approval, or PROMOTE_TO_CLIENT events. If the question touches relational data in this repo, this skill applies even if the user does not mention Neon by name.
